queries.BlockByHeight:
query BlockByHeight($height: bigint!) {
  blocks(where: {height: {_eq: $height}, canonical: {_eq: true}}) {
    ...BlockDetail
  }
}

fragment BlockDetail on blocks {
  hash
  height
  prev_hash
  time
  miner
  difficulty
  bucket_count
  bucket_id
  tx_root
  size_bytes
  canonical
  fee_total
  transfers(order_by: {position: asc}) {
    ...TransferRow
  }
  registrations(order_by: {sort_key: asc}) {
    ...RegistrationRow
  }
  proofs(order_by: {position: asc}) {
    ...ProofRow
  }
}

fragment TransferRow on transfers {
  txid
  block_hash
  height
  time
  position
  canonical
  sender
  recipient
  amount
  fee
  nonce
  sort_key
}

fragment RegistrationRow on circuits {
  txid
  circuit_id
  proof_system
  constraint_count
  registrant
  fee
}

fragment ProofRow on proofs {
  proof_hash
  request_txid
  height
  time
  position
  circuit_id
  proof_system
  client
  fee
  usage_counter
  sort_key
}
queries.BlockByHash:
query BlockByHash($hash: String!) {
  blocks(where: {hash: {_eq: $hash}}) {
    ...BlockDetail
  }
}

fragment BlockDetail on blocks {
  hash
  height
  prev_hash
  time
  miner
  difficulty
  bucket_count
  bucket_id
  tx_root
  size_bytes
  canonical
  fee_total
  transfers(order_by: {position: asc}) {
    ...TransferRow
  }
  registrations(order_by: {sort_key: asc}) {
    ...RegistrationRow
  }
  proofs(order_by: {position: asc}) {
    ...ProofRow
  }
}

fragment TransferRow on transfers {
  txid
  block_hash
  height
  time
  position
  canonical
  sender
  recipient
  amount
  fee
  nonce
  sort_key
}

fragment RegistrationRow on circuits {
  txid
  circuit_id
  proof_system
  constraint_count

  fee
}

fragment ProofRow on proofs {
  proof_hash
  request_txid

queries.Proof:
query Proof($proofHash: String!) {
  proofs(where: {proof_hash: {_eq: $proofHash}}, order_by: {canonical: desc}) {
    ...ProofRow
    block_hash
    canonical
    miner
    constraint_count
    nonce
    proof_bytes
    witness_bytes
    witness_sha256
    public_input_count
    eta
    mask
  }
}

fragment ProofRow on proofs {
  proof_hash
  request_txid
  height
  time
  position
  circuit_id
  proof_system
  client
  fee
  usage_counter
  sort_key
}
queries.Circuit:
query Circuit($circuitId: String!) {
  circuits(where: {circuit_id: {_eq: $circuitId}}) {
    ...CircuitRow
    txid
    fee
    verifying_key_bytes
    circuit_bytes
    registered_block
    registered_time
    canonical
    last_proof_height
    useful_work
  }
}

fragment CircuitRow on circuits {
  circuit_id
  proof_system
  constraint_count
  registrant
  registered_height
  proof_count
  sort_key
}
